run_colored_mnist_irm: run the colored MNIST invariant risk minimization training with configurable penalty weight and restarts
run_mlp_training: run the MLP model training on colored MNIST environments with adversarial invariance penalty
create_environment: create a colored MNIST environment with configurable color-label correlation noise rate
build_mlp_model: build a multi-layer perceptron model for binary classification on colored MNIST images
compute_penalty: compute the gradient penalty for invariant risk minimization using autograd on scaled logits
